title: Wiman-Valiron inequalities in the unit disk outside sets of finite logarithmic measure
summary: We give affirmative answers to both parts of Question 2.6 posed by Grosse-Erdmann (2025) concerning Wiman-Valiron inequalities in the unit disk. For every unbounded analytic function in the disk, we establish the proposed iterated-logarithm inequalities outside exceptional sets of finite logarithmic measure. The corresponding power estimate is a corollary. Both conclusions follow from a variance bound for Khinchin families and a classical estimate for their largest atom.
